guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 清溪川復育把水路帶回都市，也需要維持用水與公共管理。本課由集水與基流走到水力、能源、遮蔭和生態證據，分開評估景觀與河川功能。
guides.conceptEn: Cheonggyecheon returned a water corridor to the city while requiring maintenance water and public management. Follow catchment and baseflow through hydraulics, energy, shade and ecological evidence, separating appearance from function.
procedure: 先點選「城市集水區與暴雨邊界」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把C降成0.50，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 150 m³。與基準 225 m³比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「維持用水來源配對」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把Q2改成40 m³/h，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 36.66667 mg/L。與基準 24 mg/L比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「溪床斷面與人行空間」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把有效面積減至0.45 m²，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 2 m/s。與基準 1.5 m/s比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「橋梁間水路粗糙度」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把 n 改成0.020，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 5.450337 m³/s。與基準 7.267115 m³/s比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「補注供水能源帳」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把效率降成0.60，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 19.62 kW。與基準 16.35 kW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「沿岸遮蔭樣區」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把遮蔭比例提高至0.80，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 33.6 kW。與基準 25.2 kW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「狹長河岸棲地」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把有效寬度減成8 m，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 6400 m²。與基準 9600 m²比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「物種與季節調查」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把分布改成四類各0.25，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 0.75 index。與基準 0.7 index比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「水位水質監測對照」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把樣品原讀值改成16.2，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15.4 sensor unit。與基準 13.4 sensor unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「復育前後與對照街區」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把對照地事後值改成27，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 -1 indicator unit。與基準 -2 indicator unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
procedureEn: Select the urban catchment and storm boundary measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only C to0.50 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 150 m³. Compare with baseline 225 m³ and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the maintenance-water source matching measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only Q2 to40 m³/h with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 36.66667 mg/L. Compare with baseline 24 mg/L and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the channel section and pedestrian space measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only clear area to0.45 m² with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 2 m/s. Compare with baseline 1.5 m/s and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the between-bridge channel roughness measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only n to0.020 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 5.450337 m³/s. Compare with baseline 7.267115 m³/s and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the maintenance-supply energy ledger measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only efficiency to0.60 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 19.62 kW. Compare with baseline 16.35 kW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the riverside shade plots measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only shade reduction to0.80 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 33.6 kW. Compare with baseline 25.2 kW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the linear riparian habitat measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only effective width to8 m with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 6400 m². Compare with baseline 9600 m² and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the species and seasonal surveys measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only proportions to four equal0.25 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 0.75 index. Compare with baseline 0.7 index and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the level/quality sensor comparison measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only raw sample to16.2 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15.4 sensor unit. Compare with baseline 13.4 sensor unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the before-after and control streets measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only control-after to27 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute -1 indicator unit. Compare with baseline -2 indicator unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.
evidence: 畫屋頂、路面與綠地分區，分別加權C並核對雨量站。在離線場景為「城市集水區與暴雨邊界」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
檢查流量權重與採樣位置，再用混合後樣品驗證。在離線場景為「維持用水來源配對」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
比較水位、流量與有效面積，再以斷面多點量測查偏流。在離線場景為「溪床斷面與人行空間」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
量測縱坡與斷面，校準不同水位的流量曲線。在離線場景為「橋梁間水路粗糙度」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
同步量測流量、進出口壓差與真實功率，勿把視在功率當耗電。在離線場景為「補注供水能源帳」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
同時量測陰陽面表面溫度、輻射與風，採相同時段對照。在離線場景為「沿岸遮蔭樣區」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
在地圖標斷點，搭配定點觀察確認指定物種是否實際使用。在離線場景為「狹長河岸棲地」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
固定樣區、季節與採樣時長，另記棲地連續性與外來種。在離線場景為「物種與季節調查」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
用第二標準獨立驗證校正後殘差並記錄日期與溫度。在離線場景為「水位水質監測對照」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
採同期多日資料並檢查前期趨勢，不選只對結果有利的一天。在離線場景為「復育前後與對照街區」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
evidenceEn: Map roofs, pavement and vegetation, weight C separately and check rainfall data. Build an offline evidence table for urban catchment and storm boundary; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Inspect flow weights and sampling locations and verify with a downstream mixed sample. Build an offline evidence table for maintenance-water source matching; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Compare level, flow and clear area, then inspect nonuniformity with multiple section measurements. Build an offline evidence table for channel section and pedestrian space; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Measure slope and section and calibrate the discharge curve at several depths. Build an offline evidence table for between-bridge channel roughness; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Synchronize flow, pressure difference and real-power measurements; do not confuse apparent and real power. Build an offline evidence table for maintenance-supply energy ledger; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Measure shaded/unshaded surface temperature, radiation and wind concurrently. Build an offline evidence table for riverside shade plots; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Map breaks and use fixed observations to verify use by specified species. Build an offline evidence table for linear riparian habitat; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Fix plots, season and effort and separately record connectivity and invasive species. Build an offline evidence table for species and seasonal surveys; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for level/quality sensor comparison; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Use simultaneous multi-day data, inspect pre-trends and avoid selecting a favorable day. Build an offline evidence table for before-after and control streets; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
pitfalls: 把mm直接乘m²而未除1000會造成千倍錯誤。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
混合未完全就採樣會得到隨位置不同的濃度。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
只使用名目斷面會忽略攔污物或沉積造成的縮減。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
沉積與生物膜改變粗糙度，沿用初建值可能高估能力。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
葉輪磨損或閥門節流會改變工作點，須查泵曲線。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
只用紅外線表面溫度宣稱人體降溫會混淆指標。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
廊道被道路切斷時，相同面積仍可能失去連通。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
採樣努力量增加會製造看似改善，須對照基線。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
處理地同時換交通流量會讓單一干預歸因失真。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
pitfallsEn: Multiplying mm bym² without dividing by1000 gives a thousandfold error. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Sampling before complete mixing yields position-dependent concentrations. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Nominal area misses reductions caused by debris or sediment. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Sediment and biofilm alter roughness; an as-built value may overestimate capacity. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Impeller wear or throttling changes the operating point; inspect the pump curve. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Claiming human cooling from infrared surface temperature alone confuses indicators. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
A road break can destroy connectivity despite unchanged area. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Greater sampling effort can mimic improvement; compare with the baseline. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Concurrent traffic changes at the treated site confound attribution. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.

guides.scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。

related.why: 比較兩個系統的物質或能量收支，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。

related.difference: 設備尺度、進料組成與品質目標必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Equipment scale, feed composition and quality objectives require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.
